correctness.rationale: Exact five-by-five nonattacking rook complex; enumerate 1545 faces and the 60 even permutations, obtain (45,308,744,720,240) orbit CW cells. All boundary-squared identities hold. Verify 240 then 404 true free-face collapses to (45,308,340,76). Unimodular integer elimination yields boundary Smith factors 1^44, 1^264 and (1^74,5,5); therefore H2=(Z/5)^2 and no other reduced H. Classical 1994 connectivity theorem gives simply connected input, A5 is generated by 3-cycles with fixed vertices so Armstrong gives quotient pi1=0, and Hurewicz/homological Whitehead identify the wedge of two Moore spaces. The standalone verify.py executes all finite arithmetic.

value.rationale: This is a natural index-two parity refinement of simultaneous relabeling on a classical chessboard complex. It completely determines the integral homotopy type, revealing two five-primary Moore summands where the larger full symmetric quotient has only one. The exact extra torsion direction is invisible to rational homology and is not forced by source theorems; it is a motivated structural symmetry comparison, not an arbitrary slice.
